thread:
elaine_sales: Hey all — AcmeTech ready to sign the POC order form but procurement sent back MSA+DPA redlines. Key asks: HSM key custody, EU-only data residency, SLA 99.9% with credits, and CFO wants net-60 + PO on invoice. Any immediate blockers?

yusuf_legal: Can you upload their redline PDF and highlight the HSM/DPA language they changed? I can target specific clause text. Also cc procurement contact.

elaine_sales: Uploaded: https://files.redwood/recontracts/acmetech_redline_v3.pdf. Quick summary they removed our standard KMS clause, replaced with "Customer shall hold keys in HSM under Customer control", and added a hard EU residency requirement + net-60 payment term.

maria_ops: Heads-up — HSM-backed BYOK/attestation is only supported on Private (customer-managed infra) or Dedicated with HSM gateway enabled. Hosted API cannot provide customer HSM custody. EU-only residency is doable but requires provisioning in EU region and data egress rules.

sam_eng: Technical note: we support BYOK via KMS integrations (AWS KMS/CloudHSM, GCP CloudKMS). HSM attestation + hardware proof-of-ownership requires Private deployment. Timeline to enable on Dedicated w/ HSM gateway: ~3–4 weeks (procurement + infra config).

devon_finance: Net-60 is larger than our standard 30-day terms — needs Finance exec approval. We can approve net-60 for strategic deals but need updated credit docs. Also, PO on invoice is fine.

redwood_deploybot: DocuSign integration status: PASS. Sequential signing and multiple signers supported. Invoice field placeholders (PO#, billing contact) available.

yusuf_legal: Proposed approach: 1) Offer Dedicated/Private deployment to satisfy HSM + residency. 2) Counter their redline with language: "Customer may use customer-managed HSMs subject to attestation and security review; Redwood remains processor under DPA with defined data flows." I will draft suggested DPA text and a limited SLA credit table (avoid open-ended liability).

elaine_sales: Customer requires 2 signers (Legal + CFO) and wants sequential DocuSign flow. Also asked that the order form show the final monthly commitment and a POC discount line.

devon_finance: POC discount ok — we'll put a 25% POC discount line and note final committed rates post-POC. Pricing for Dedicated in order form: 8 x A100 nodes, support tier 2, monthly. I'll attach updated invoice template once legal signs off on net-60.

maria_ops: One more ops note: if we go Dedicated and they need EU-only residency, we must update network allowlist + the onboarding runbook to include HSM attestation steps and legal checklist. This adds ~1 week to onboarding after infra is ready.

yusuf_legal: I'll produce a succinct redline with alternative DPA language and a narrowly-scoped SLA credit (e.g., 5% of monthly invoice for Sev1 SLA misses beyond two incidents). Will share within 24 hours. Please confirm procurement contact to CC.

elaine_sales: Procurement contact is jenny.procure@acmetech.com. I'll loop them in and push for signatures. Can Finance add PO field to invoice template and notify accounting?

devon_finance: I'll update invoice template now and send to @elaine_sales when done.

sam_eng: Adding HSM attestation section to onboarding runbook — will push change by EOD tomorrow.

elaine_sales: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll coordinate signatures and confirm whether they accept Dedicated (preferred) or require Private. Will report back after procurement reply. :thumbsup:
